rules.fact: Every remote fetch must include AbortSignal.timeout(3500) to prevent hung sockets.
rules.title: Mandatory AbortSignal.timeout on External API Calls
rules.rationale: External API services can hang indefinitely. Every remote fetch must have an explicit timeout between 2,500ms and 3,500ms.
rules.code_pattern: const res = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3500) });
rules.anti_pattern: Calling fetch() on external services without an AbortSignal timeout.
